concept.title: Supported housing and accommodation help
concept.shortdesc: Receiving housing or accommodation itself, or hands-on help to find a home and keep a tenancy, especially for people who are homeless or need support.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.
